title: Filings Unit Memorandum: Certificate Run-Off and the Days Returned When the Insured Cancels an Owner Auto Policy
content:
**Rule.** When an Owner Auto Policy term is cancelled at the named insured's request, the days returned depend on the SR-22 or FR-44 certificate the term backs, a filing under the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44).

**Standing on the cancellation effective date.** Every certificate backed by the term is read as it stood on the cancellation effective date, so an SR-26 transmitted after that date does not change the reading. A certificate stood filed on that date when either holds:
- the certificate entered first with status filed has its filed date on or before that date; or
- the certificate entered first with status cancellation filed has its filed date on or before that date and its SR-26 date after it.

**Days returned.**
1. **Term written to back a certificate, and a certificate backed by the term stood filed on the cancellation effective date.** The days returned are the calendar days from the cancellation effective date to the expiration date, less the certificate's run-off days, never below zero, because the company stays bound to the state until the SR-26 takes effect. A term is written to back a certificate when its record of the certificate the policy backs names SR-22 or FR-44. The run-off days are the certificate's figure, as the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) schedule sets it.
2. **Term written to back a certificate, none backed by it stood filed on that date, and one has status cancellation filed with its SR-26 transmitted (its SR-26 date) on or before that date.** The days returned run from the later of the cancellation effective date and that certificate's certificate end date, to the expiration date, never below zero. When several certificates have the status cancellation filed, the certificate entered first is used.
3. **Otherwise.** The days returned run from the cancellation effective date to the expiration date.

In every case the cancellation effective date is counted and the expiration date is not. The days returned set here are the count from which any further days the company keeps are then taken off, never below zero.

**Records read.** The term's record of the certificate the policy backs (SR-22, FR-44 or none); and, for each Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) certificate backed by the term, its status (filed, cancellation filed), filed date, SR-26 date, certificate end date and run-off days.

| Term backs a certificate | Standing on the cancellation effective date | Days returned run |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | a certificate stood filed | cancellation effective date to expiration, less the run-off days |
| Yes | none stood filed; a cancellation-filed certificate's SR-26 dated on or before that date | later of the cancellation effective date and the certificate end date, to expiration |
| Yes | neither | cancellation effective date to expiration |
| No | any | cancellation effective date to expiration |

**Hypothetical illustration.** The insured's cancellation takes effect 40 days before expiration on a term backing an FR-44.
- If the FR-44 stood filed on that date and its run-off days were 10, 30 days are returned.
- If its SR-26 was dated before the cancellation effective date and its certificate end date falls 45 days after the cancellation, no days are returned.
